title: feat(typescript): add declaration files
body:
**Summary**

Fixes #3562

Since we recently migrated to TypeScript 3.7 (https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/pull/4097), we can now generate declaration files for the library consumers even if the TypeScript migration is not finished yet.

It is possible thanks to the new [`--declaration` and `--allowJS` support](http://www.typescriptlang.org/docs/handbook/release-notes/typescript-3-7.html#--declaration-and---allowjs).

Even with a partial migration we get some pretty good declaration files even if we still have 197 `any` on the public API (the existing JSDocs helped here). What is mainly missing is inline documentation tho, but this is still way better than what currently exists IMHO.

Since we heavily rely on JSDoc in JavaScript files the risk is to have some incorrect types declared, this is not an issue a long as it is not in the public API (we do not use `checkJS` in development).

To check the public API I used [`api-extractor`](https://api-extractor.com) to generate some report files: https://gist.github.com/yannickcr/e46632add9a98578269616613a5bad56 Let me know if you see any issue.

(**Theses files are not part of this PR**, this is just an extraction of what was generated to help to find some incorrect types.)
